data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating / tracking Nifty 500 Value 50 Total Return Index [TRI]
data.investment_objective: The Investment objective of the Scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, corresponds to the total return of the securities as represented by the underlying index, subject to tracking error. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Securities covered by Nifty 500 Value 50 Index : 95% To 100% (Medium to High), Debt / Money Market instruments including Triparty Repo on Government Securities or treasury bill and units of Liquid Mutual Fund 0% to 5% (Low)
data.fund_managers: Mr Sharwan Kumar Goyal FM 1, Mr. Ayush Jain FM 2
